fallback: That didn't work — please try again.
network: Network request failed. Check your connection and retry.
HTTP_401: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
HTTP_403: You don't have permission to do that.
HTTP_404: We couldn't find what you asked for.
HTTP_409: That conflicted with another change. Refresh and retry.
HTTP_500: The server hit an error. Please try again shortly.
SANDBOX_NOT_READY: The sandbox isn't ready yet — create one first.
SESSION_BUSY: The session is still running — hold on.
HTTP_429: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
SESSION_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached the conversation limit ({{used}}/{{limit}}), so a new one cannot start. Delete some old conversations and try again — existing ones still work.
CONCURRENT_AGENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Too many tasks are running at once ({{used}}/{{limit}}). Wait for one to finish, or stop one.
CONTAINER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached the sandbox limit ({{used}}/{{limit}}). Release one you are not using.
